text:
Maya: hey all, I'm Maya joining Platform. Trying to follow the kube quickstart but I get Forbidden when accessing `platform-tools` namespace. Any fast path for new hires? :wave:

Maya: error:
```
$ kubectl get pods -n platform-tools
Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "okta|maya@redwood.com" cannot list resource "pods" in API group "" in the namespace "platform-tools"
```

devex-bot: welcome Maya! :tada: Please open the self-serve form: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/kube-access. For first week choose TTL=ephemeral:7d and access=view. Infra is notified automatically.

Maya: thanks — before I file, is there a way to check if my Okta groups synced?

infra: run `kubectl config view --minify -o jsonpath='{.users[0].name}'` to confirm the user field, and `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n platform-tools`. If impersonation tests pass, we can mirror the onboard serviceaccount binding.

Maya: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n platform-tools` -> no. I ran the user check and it shows `okta|maya@redwood.com`

infra: ok, file the form and ping this thread. For immediate read-only access we can create a `rolebinding/platform-onboard-maya` bound to the `view` ClusterRole. We require the ticket for audit TTL enforcement.

Maya: filed ticket KUBE-7810, TTL=7d, access=view. Link: https://tickets.redwood.com/KUBE-7810

infra: applied rolebinding. Try now.

Maya: success!
```
$ kubectl get pods -n platform-tools
NAME                         READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
ctler-sync-86f9b             1/1     Running   0          10d
metrics-agent-6b7c4          2/2     Running   1          3d
```

Jordan: welcome Maya :thumbsup: if you need edit later, ping infra with codeowner approval.

Maya: thanks everyone! This helped a lot :)
